tasks.short: Lay out pipe routes with supervisors

steps.what: Interpret written instructions or blueprints and coordinate pipe route layouts with supervisors
Lay out pipe routes on site and check correspondence with clarified instructions
outputs: questions or differences requiring supervisor resolution

tasks.design: Retain instruction interpretation, supervisor coordination and physical layout. Controlled originals in {DOCS} support the work; a digital drawing does not establish the actual site references or complete the layout.
tasks.previous_blocker: A planned route must be reconciled with conditions and references on the site.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest covers construction paperwork and does not establish automatic physical pipe layout.
tasks.still_hard: Differences between plans and actual conditions require supervisor clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when the physical route cannot be inferred confidently from the available instruction.
tasks.altitude: Physical layout and coordination retain their full time.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of construction trades and extraction workers
reach.learn: How site constraints affect the application of a plan

evidence.claim: Pipe route layout requires plan interpretation and physical site work; construction record tools do not establish a local layout-time saving.

assumptions: Boundary is layout and supervisor coordination, excluding engineering design, original surveying, excavation and pipe installation.

Responsible designers and supervisors supply current instructions and references before s1 closes. The pipelayer checks versions, interprets requirements and obtains clarification within s1's retained 40 hours; actual observations and marking checks remain in s2's 60 hours. New differences return for supervisor resolution. No free structured route, valid site-reference or route-approved flag is assumed.
Use controlled documents and existing site methods first. No new digital survey feed, worker data-entry duty or tool upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual site reference control and layout authority
research_questions: Which route discrepancies require supervisor or design clarification before layout can be resolved?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Physical layout and coordination remain human work; paperwork case figures are not transferred.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train or supervise pipe laying workers

steps.what: Train or supervise others in laying pipe through explanation, observation and corrective guidance

tasks.design: Retain direct training and supervision of actual work. Existing instructions in {DOCS} support explanation; a recorded acknowledgement cannot substitute for observing an attempt and answering questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training and direction depend on what workers do in the immediate context.
tasks.enabler_now: No separate material-authoring or reporting share is established by this task.
tasks.still_hard: A worker may repeat instructions without understanding how to apply them.
tasks.human_edge: Notice misunderstanding and adapt the explanation or seek responsible expertise.
tasks.altitude: Protect direct instruction and supervision time.

reach.role: helper, pipelayer, plumber, pipefitter and steamfitter
reach.task: Clarify a work instruction during practice
reach.learn: How an observed attempt reveals what needs explanation

evidence.claim: Live pipe-laying training and supervision require observation and adaptation; no local software time saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is focal pipelayer training or supervision, excluding workers' production labour, course authoring and formal certification. Shared site coordination with route layout is counted once.

Responsible personnel provide instructions before use; workers supply questions and observable attempts during s1 before guidance closes. Checking understanding and clarifying uncertainty remain retained; no free competent-worker or satisfactory-work flag is assumed.
Use existing instructions and direct demonstration first. No extra trainee reporting, new tool or maintenance is proposed.
unknowns: Actual training authority and worker support needs
research_questions: Which misunderstandings only appear during observed practice?

already_counted.description: Explanation, live observation and situational supervision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Training and supervision retain their time; worker production hours are excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep route interpretation, physical layout and direct worker guidance explicit rather than attributing paperwork capability to site work.
reach: Resolve route differences with site supervisors
Adapt explanations to helpers' observed attempts
role.ambitious_version: A pipelayer with clear route requirements and time protected for layout and direct guidance.
